one_liner: Time tracking and invoicing software for teams and projects

evidence.claim: Harvest API V2 supports Personal Access Tokens created self-serve from the Developers section of Harvest ID
evidence.quote: The API can be accessed by creating a Personal Access Token from the **Developers** section of Harvest ID. After creating it you'll be provided with a random token and a list of your account IDs.

evidence.claim: Harvest API V2 also supports full OAuth2 Authorization Code flow with access and refresh tokens
evidence.quote: Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations.

evidence.claim: API requests authenticate via Bearer token in Authorization header plus Harvest-Account-Id header against api.harvestapp.com REST endpoints
The v2 API surface spans many resource groups including Clients, Invoices, Estimates, Expenses, Tasks, Timesheets, Projects, Roles, Users, and Reports, indicating broad coverage
Harvest maintains current v2 REST API documentation with a Postman collection and code samples, legacy v1 deprecated
evidence.quote: This is the current API V2 documentation. You can still view the legacy API V1 documentation.

notes: Greenhouse has a separate unrelated 'Harvest' API (support.greenhouse.io result) — not this app. No evidence of an official MCP server in vendor docs. Harvest offers a free plan and trial, and PAT creation is self-serve via id.getharvest.com/developers, so credentials are obtainable without sales contact.
